messages:
Mateo Santos: Hi all — Mateo here, day one on Platform (PT). Super excited! Quick things: I don’t see org Slack access and my laptop status says "label printed" but no tracking. Who should I poke?
Jules Park: Welcome Mateo :tada: I’m Jules, your manager. I’ll ping IT. 1:1 at 2pm PT today.
Rae (People Ops): Hey Mateo :wave: I resent the onboarding packet to mateo.santos@personal.email. Check spam too. Badge pickup is optional; if you need it we can schedule.
IT Desk: Hi Mateo — laptop shows "in transit" with ETA tomorrow. For temporary work, we can create a scoped laptop-less account. To SSH into the test bastion use: ```ssh mateo_temp@bastion.redwood.internal -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_temp``` Password via DM.
Mateo Santos: Thanks! I tried joining the org invite but SSO redirects to a signup page I don’t recognize. Is that expected?
Marta Li: @Mateo I’ll check your SSO mapping. Please confirm the email used for sign-up so I can sync groups. Also added you to #platform and #new-hires.
Mateo Santos: Confirming: mateo.santos@personal.email. Also any recommended first-run reading for the Platform runbooks?
Jules Park: Start with "platform/onboarding/first-48h" and the deploy runbook. Marta dropped links in DM.
DevEx Bot: New-hire checklist created for Mateo Santos — tasks: enroll SSO, complete MDM, security training, join required channels.
Mateo Santos: Got the runbook links, thanks. Fun fact: I once rode a motorcycle across three countries in two days and still lost exactly one glove :motorcycle:. Also I make a mean arepa.
Rae (People Ops): Love the adventure! We'll add an arepa lunch to the welcome calendar :plate_with_cutlery:
IT Desk: SSO mapping fixed — you should be able to accept the invite now. If you still see the redirect, clear cookies or try incognito.
Mateo Santos: Accepted the invite and can access Slack now. Enrolled MDM and device shows in the portal. Thanks everyone for the speedy help.
Jules Park: Great — welcome to Platform, Mateo. We'll kick off pairing tomorrow and get you a small-first-issue to start.
Mateo Santos: Looking forward to it — appreciate the warm welcome!
